title: 第21章 人生如果没有梦想那和咸鱼有什么区别第22章 我对你的敬仰有如滔滔江水连绵不绝
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姜云天整理了一下思绪，有一点可以肯定，青鸳不会伤及他性命，毕竟青鸳、青瑶、青儿三个对他是有感情的，退一万步来说，也有深深的交情。
虽说在修仙的人来说，这种道侣关系一般都是各取所需，但他对自己是有信心的。
现在当下就是要搞定小狸，让青鸳不再因为爆炸受伤一事对其进行怨恨，现在他觉得怨恨都不见得有了，有的是因爱生恨的折磨，他觉得青鸳就是想折磨他。
至于青瑶和青儿，应该就是听命于青鸳。
所以当下第一步，搞定小狸，让她证明自己的清白，第二步搞定清鸳，绝对不能让误会延续下去。
想到此，他看向了小狸，小狸依然是老样子，可爱的在睡觉，小猫的咕噜声持续。
小狸在假寐中，她也在想怎么能和姜云天修练，让自己起飞呢。
虽然做为妖兽一族，对这种双修的事，是没有什么心理负担的，但姜云天修练的双修神功，明显品级很高。
她可以抢，但抢过来以后，不还得和姜云天双修才会有神果吗。
所以抢是抢不来的。
要慢慢来。
她也是心里一阵猫抓。
没有想到更好的办法，现在有了空闲，就打开系统看看。
姜云天打开系统信息面板：
姜云天：26岁
境界，筑基境九重
功法：星辰诀---超越天级
灵根：复合灵根---超越天级
武技：阴阳合神功大成
、五行遁小成圆满、五行阵小成小成圆满，斗转星移入门圆满、擎天功大成，破剑术入门圆满

武器：仙品五行剑
阵器：圣级五行剑阵入门
丹药：极品练气丹50、极品凝气丹50、极品破凡丹5、极品破障丹5、极品凝魂丹5、极品疗伤丹72.极品爆体丹1。
符箓：极品灭魂火符1，极品灭魂冰符1、极品灭神火符1、极品灭神冰符1
姜云天看到面板，阴阳化神果消失，极品疗伤丹减少，这些都是小狸消耗的，心中又是下定决心，一定要更快搞定小狸。
当看到阴阳合神功大成了？擎天功大成了？，他是心中狂喜。
这两天被三女极限施压，竞然有这么大的提高，他兴奋不已。
看来这也不是白白付出啊。
姜云天心中大笑道：“青鸳，青瑶、青儿，你们来啊，继续修炼啊，我巴不得呢！
！”
看到自己的系统属性面板，姜云天也是一扫之前的颓废之气，他真的觉得，青鸳三女太好了，如果夜夜当新郞，日日美娇娘。
他的修仙大业指日可待啊。
“如果青鸳三女一直把他关在这里，日日修炼，那有多好啊，我好期待啊，修仙大业一片坦途，青鸳，你们圈养我吧，我不会在意的，就这样一直下去，日日如此，就是人生最终的梦想。
是啊，人一定要有梦想，如果没有梦想，那和咸鱼有什么区别！
，青鸳，我不想努力了，青瑶我不想努力了，青儿我不想努力了，只要你们努力修炼，我的梦想一定能实现！
！”
content_en:
Jiang Yuntian sorted out his thoughts, and one thing was certain, Qingyuan would not hurt his life. After all, Qingyuan, Qingyao, and Qing'er had feelings for him. Even if they took a step back, they had a deep friendship.
Although for those who cultivate immortality, this kind of relationship between Taoists and Taoists is usually about each getting what he wants, but he has confidence in himself.
What he needs to do now is to get rid of Xiaoli so that Qingyuan will no longer resent him because of the injury in the explosion. Now he feels that resentment may not be there anymore, but rather the torture of love and hatred. He feels that Qingyuan just wants to torture him.
As for Qingyao and Qing'er, they should just take orders from Qingyuan.
Therefore, the first step is to deal with Xiaoli and let her prove her innocence. The second step is to deal with Qingyuan. The misunderstanding must not be allowed to continue.
Thinking of this, he looked at Xiaoli. Xiaoli was still the same, sleeping cutely, and the kitten's purring continued.
Xiaoli was in a nap, and she was also thinking about how to train with Jiang Yuntian to make herself take off.
Although as a member of the monster clan, there is no psychological burden on this kind of dual cultivation, but Jiang Yuntian's dual cultivation of magical skills is obviously of a very high level.
She could snatch it, but after snatching it away, wouldn't she have to cultivate with Jiang Yuntian to get the magical fruit?
So you can't grab it.
Take your time.
She also felt scratched in her heart.
I didn't think of a better way, so now that I have some free time, I opened the system and took a look.
Jiang Yuntian opened the system information panel:
Jiang Yuntian: 26 years old
Realm, ninth level of foundation building realm
Kung Fu: Star Technique---Beyond Heaven Level
Spiritual Root: Composite Spiritual Root---Beyond Heaven Level
Martial Arts: Yin-Yang Combination of Divine Skills
, The Five Elements Escape is a small success, the Five Elements Formation is a small success, the Star Movement is a small success, the sky-holding skill is a big success, the Sword Breaking Technique is a small success
Weapon: Immortal Five Elements Sword
Array: Introduction to the Saint-Level Five Elements Sword Array
Pills: 50 top quality Qi training pills, 50 top quality Qi condensation pills, 5 top quality mortal breaking pills, 5 top quality barrier breaking pills, 5 top quality soul condensing pills, 72 top quality healing pills, and 1 top quality body explosive pill.
Talisman: 1 top-quality soul-killing fire talisman, 1 top-quality soul-killing ice talisman, 1 top-quality god-killing fire talisman, 1 top-quality god-killing ice talisman
Jiang Yuntian saw the panel. The Yin-Yang Transformation Fruit disappeared and the best healing pills decreased. These were all consumed by Xiaoli, and he made up his mind to get rid of Xiaoli faster.
When you see the yin and yang combined with the magic power? Is the power of raising heaven complete? , he was ecstatic in his heart.
Having been put under extreme pressure by the three women in the past two days, Jingran was so excited that he had improved so much.
It seems that this is not in vain.
Jiang Yuntian laughed in his heart and said: "Qingyuan, Qingyao, Qing'er, come on, keep practicing, I can't wait to do it!
! "
Seeing his system properties panel, Jiang Yuntian also wiped away his previous decadence. He really felt that the three Qingyuan girls were so good. If they were brides every night, they would be beautiful every day.
His great cause of cultivating immortality is just around the corner.
"How wonderful it would be if the three Qingyuan girls kept him here and practiced every day. I'm really looking forward to it. The great cause of cultivating immortals will be smooth. Qingyuan, just keep me captive. I won't care. If it goes on like this, every day, this is the ultimate dream of life.
Yes, people must have dreams. If there is no dream, what is the difference between it and salted fish!
, Qingyuan, I don’t want to work hard anymore, Qingyao, I don’t want to work hard anymore, Qing’er, I don’t want to work hard anymore, as long as you practice hard, my dream will definitely come true!
! "
